sql: WITH oc AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.order_id,p.product_category_name category FROM olist_order_items i JOIN olist_products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL), counts AS (SELECT category,payment_type,COUNT(*) number_of_payments FROM oc JOIN olist_order_payments USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2), ranked AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY category ORDER BY number_of_payments DESC,payment_type) rn FROM counts) SELECT category,payment_type,number_of_payments FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY number_of_payments DESC,category LIMIT 3
